title: Punti–Hakka Clan Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Punti–Hakka Clan Wars", at revision 1363553705, opens: "The Punti–Hakka Clan Wars were an ethnic conflict between the Hakka and the Cantonese, both Han Chinese subgroups, fought largely in the Guangdong region of China which was then under the Qing Empire. Occurring between 1855 and 1868, the fighting was most intense in the Pearl River Delta, especially in Toi Shan of the Sze Yup counties. The wars resulted in up to one million deaths and the displacement of many more civilians." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q838771, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "mid-19th century conflict in Guangdong, China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
